preparation_readme:
# #368 source-only diagnostic fix

Isolated worktree: `/Users/jason/.codex/worktrees/verdify-probe-validity-368/verdify-platform`; base39dbedd6. The changes are uncommitted for the root composer. Apply `probe-validity.patch` to the same base or inspect the worktree directly.

The count now counts complete finite temperature/RH/VPD wall probes within the existing300s window. Probe Health checks finite values as well as its earlier120s freshness window and reports fresh invalid samples as `INVALID`; stale takes precedence. At exactly120s it now reports STALE consistently with the shared strict freshness predicate. Case checks temperature/RH only because it has no corresponding VPD entity. Entity names and all three aggregate definitions are unchanged. A partial probe can still contribute its valid field to one aggregate; the count's documentation explicitly describes complete probes rather than falsely claiming equal membership of every aggregate.

Three native C++ regression cases are prepared in the existing firmware test runner: missing/stale/NaN/Inf fields, valid steady observations/zero VPD/uint32 wrap, and early health warning while aggregate eligibility remains. `git diff --check` passed and aggregate definitions were verified byte-for-byte unchanged. The tests have NOT RUN; no native or ESPHome compile, replay, image build or OTA was performed.

Root must admit existing cluster firmware qualification before delivery: `test-firmware`, `firmware-invariants`, required replay diff, and `firmware-check` under the repository contract. Keep#368 open for stuck/jump plausibility, explicit control validity/quorum and remaining physical acceptance; keep#390 firmware delivery qualification separate. This is a small diagnostic fix, not a sensor replacement or endpoint substitution.
